Stock market news | SEBI appoints forensic auditor in ₹3,535-crore Coffee Day case

On 26 November 2026, SEBI named a forensic auditor to examine the alleged ₹3,535-crore fund diversion by Coffee Day Enterprises, as directed by a tribunal.
The investigation will trace fund beneficiaries and review bank accounts, aiming to ensure market integrity and protect investors.
